sources_tested: Canon row 1976.001; DFHG Müller–Jacoby concordance; Brill Jacoby Online historian index; targeted FGrH 184/Metrodorus of Scepsis searches; Digital Athenaeus index; local FHG III scan register; official Internet Archive item and remote page/Greek visual checks
open_text_result: No complete reusable Greek transcription of Jacoby’s discrete testimonia section (FGrH 184, pp.912–914) was verified. Brill’s Jacoby Online identifies the author/number but is a scholarly access service, not a reusable text grant. No provider OCR was used.
open_text_license: No open-text licence for the original FGrH testimonia or Brill’s online edition was verified.
scan_result: A public scan of the earlier Müller, Fragmenta Historicorum Graecorum III (Paris, 1849), pp.203–205 was located. Remote visual checks at its pp.203 and 205 show the heading ‘METRODORUS SCEPSIUS’ and legible Greek citations; it is a useful source-discovery/concordance candidate but not proof of the exact Jacoby T-section boundaries.
scan_rights: The 1849 edition is public domain, but the Internet Archive item/scan supplies no explicit digitisation or public-redistribution licence. The local register expressly records this rights gap. Do not deem its images HF-public-ready without a compatible source-rights determination.

notes: The author is Metrodorus of Scepsis (FGrH 184), confirmed by DFHG.
